title: Drone Strikes Kill 100+ in Khartoum and RSF-Held West Kordofan, Nyala
detail: AFP-reported drone strikes on Khartoum and two RSF-held western areas killed more than 100 people from Sunday Oct 18, per residents, medical workers and paramilitary sources. The deadliest hit a transport hub in Al-Dibab, West Kordofan, killing about 80; a separate strike on Nyala killed 17. The RSF-run administration and a rights group blamed the army, which has not commented. An earlier aggregator headline cited 160 dead; that figure is unverified.
